tool.name: Grok Bot
tool.description: xAI's always-on bots with their own cloud computers that work across apps 24/7; Team Bots add shared bots for Teams and Enterprise plans.
strengths: Separate usage pool from Grok/Cursor plans
Shared Team Bots deployable in Slack
tool.pricing: Included (beta) with SuperGrok, SuperGrok Plus/Heavy, Cursor Pro/Pro+/Ultra and Cursor Teams plans; enterprise via sales.
tool.statusNote: Beta: launched 2026-08-11, expanded to more plans 2026-08-26; Team Bots in public beta on Teams and Enterprise plans since 2026-09-28; enterprise waitlist.
tool.practitionerNote: Bots hold credentials and act across tools while unattended, so scope plugin credentials tightly. xAI has not published enterprise compliance detail for Bots, so treat it as a pilot rather than a regulated-workload option.

dataResidency.detail: No data-residency options stated in the Grok Bot or Team Bots announcements.

deployment.detail: xAI-hosted; each bot runs on its own cloud computer, accessed from desktop and iOS.

auditLogging.detail: Announcements do not describe audit logs or admin activity logs.

soc2.detail: xAI announcement pages link to security and privacy portals but do not state certification scope for Grok Bot.

euAiAct.detail: General-purpose agent product; risk class depends on use and the vendor has not published an EU AI Act classification.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary xAI service bundled with Grok/Cursor subscriptions.
